digest.component_or_area: live integration test harness for multi-project Jira reconciliation
propositions: Live Cloud rehearsal against two shared projects masks real Jira failure modes: non-existent project keys parse-error rather than return empty, and insufficient projects to model all repo configurations and error paths

Ephemeral Jira DC instance with admin rights and dynamically provisioned throwaway projects enables reproducible multi-project scenarios covering one/two/zero repos, empty projects, and unknown project fail-closed behavior
Per-scenario dry-run gating via bridge preview ensures each mutation targets only its intended project with empty intersection against all other configured projects before sync executes

Session-scoped fixture provisions N scratch projects with pinned template and capability verification, tears down on all exit paths via poll-until-404 delete, and guards against leaked projects from prior runs
